items.name: base
items.title: ViteHub base
items.description: Start an app on ViteHub UI: `shadcn-vue init --preset https://vitehub.dev/r/base.json`. It adds the @vitehub registry, Lucide icons, the theme, and the core stylesheet. It installs no Reka UI.

items.name: theme
items.title: ViteHub theme
items.description: The shadcn tokens with ViteHub values, light and dark.

items.name: core
items.title: ViteHub core
items.description: vitehub.css: the ui-sdk stylesheet, the shadcn tokens mapped onto its --ui-* variables, the status colors, and the focus ring. Every component item imports it.

items.name: status
items.title: Status
items.description: A dot in a status color with an optional label.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy button
items.description: A button that copies text and shows a check for a moment.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A button in the ViteHub look: solid, outline, soft, ghost, link, and destructive, with a loading state.

items.name: icon
items.title: Icon
items.description: A frame that sizes a Lucide icon and names it, or hides it from screen readers.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A one-line text field with a blue focus frame and an invalid state.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text field with the look of Input.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: The name of a form control.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A form control with its label, description, and error, linked for screen readers.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short text that shows when the pointer rests on its trigger or the trigger has focus.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A pulsing block that holds the place of content that loads.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: The empty state of a list or a page: an icon, a title, a description, and actions.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A message in a status color that the page shows in its flow.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A short label in a status color.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A surface with a header, content, and a footer.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A keyboard key or a key combination.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: An image of a person or a project, with initials when the image does not load.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal window over a dimmed page, with a close button in the corner.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that slides in from an edge of the viewport. A long body scrolls.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: A menu of actions, checkboxes, and radio items that a button opens.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs on a 1px line, with an indicator that slides to the selected tab.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A data table with a header, rows, and a caption.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A searchable list of commands, inline or as a palette in a dialog.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Short notifications in a corner of the viewport. Call toast() from anywhere.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: An app sidebar that collapses to a rail of icons on desktop and is a sheet on mobile. Ctrl+B or Cmd+B toggles it.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App shell
items.description: An app layout: a sidebar of grouped links and a header that sticks to the top of the page.
